title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression checks and quality gating
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: We need automated gating for prompt-set regressions so model-serving changes and prompt edits cannot accidentally degrade user-facing prompts. This PR introduces a CI hook that runs the eval-harness against changed prompt sets and compares a small set of eval metrics against stored baselines. Motivation: caught regressions earlier in CI reduces rollbacks and manual QA effort. Summary of changes: 1) GitHub Actions job .github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml that detects changed prompts in the PR and runs a lightweight eval job (sampled prompts, short model run) 2) tools/eval_ci/check_regressions.py - core regression-checker that computes metrics (exact-match, rouge-l, consistency score) and compares against thresholds from .eval/thresholds.json 3) .eval/thresholds.json - per-prompt-set gating config with soft/hard thresholds and tolerances 4) integrations/eval_metrics/uploader.py - optional hook to upload metrics to our eval metrics BigQuery dataset for historical tracking 5) tests: tests/eval_ci/test_check_regressions.py with small fixtures and CI mock for baseline comparisons 6) docs: docs/ci/eval-harness-ci.md with usage and override guidance Implementation notes: - The CI runs a sampled, deterministic subset of prompts to keep run time <12 minutes on hosted runners. - Thresholds support soft-fail (warn) vs hard-fail (block merge). The default for newly added prompt sets is soft until product triage approves hard gating. - For private deployments the hook skips uploader and uses a local baseline file; the script respects REDWOOD_EVAL_MODE=private. Migration: existing thresholds file seeded from the last stable eval snapshot. New CI job is guarded by an opt-in label 'run-eval-ci' until we finish rollout training. Checklist: - [x] Core regression checker script - [x] GitHub Actions workflow - [x] Thresholds JSON seeded - [x] Unit tests - [x] Documentation - [x] Reviewer feedback addressed CI: initial runs failed on a race in metrics upload (uploader retried); fixed with exponential backoff commit. Final CI run: all checks passed. Security: uploader uses existing BigQuery service account and follows our secrets guidelines (no creds in repo). Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes to eval-harness API. Related: ENG-1423 (eval gating epic), SUP-4210 (support ticket requesting automated prompt checks).

release_notes: Add CI hook for eval-harness prompt regression checks and quality gating. New workflow runs lightweight evaluations on changed prompt-sets and blocks merges when metrics cross configured thresholds. Opt-in label available during rollout.
notes_for_release: Rollout will be gradual: CI opt-in label initially. Engineering will flip opt-in to opt-out after 2 weeks of monitoring and false-positive tuning.
discussion_summary: Design focused on fast, deterministic checks in PRs. Reviewers requested clearer sampling docs and robust uploader retries. We kept gating configurable per prompt-set with soft/hard thresholds to avoid blocking new prompts during initial rollout.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for comparator logic. CI runs sample eval jobs on hosted runners; integration test for uploader mocked BigQuery and passed after retry fix.
why_this_change: Prevent regressions introduced by model-run path or prompt edits from reaching production by adding automated, enforceable checks in CI.
how_to_approve: Code review + CI green. Product sign-off on threshold changes required before flipping soft->hard for a prompt-set.
